question_hindi: पॉवर प्वाइंट में प्रत्येक पेज ___ कहलाता है।
question_english: In PowerPoint, each page is called ___.
explanation: Each page of a PowerPoint presentation is called a Slide.
trap_point: Worksheet is an Excel term, not PowerPoint.
revision_fact: A single unit of a PPT presentation is a Slide.

question_hindi: MS Power Point पर आधारित है-
question_english: MS PowerPoint is based on-
explanation: PowerPoint uses a Graphical User Interface (GUI) with icons, menus and ribbons.
trap_point: CUI/AUI/RBI are distractor acronyms with no real meaning here.
memory_trick: GUI = Graphics you see, click, and use.
revision_fact: PowerPoint, like all MS Office apps, is GUI-based.

question_hindi: निम्न में से Slide Show किसमें होता है?
question_english: Slide Show is present in-
explanation: Slide Show is a PowerPoint-specific feature to display slides full-screen.
memory_trick: Slide Show = Show only in PowerPoint.
revision_fact: Slide Show is a core PowerPoint feature.

question_hindi: Graphic Presentation Program में प्रत्येक प्रेजेंटेशन ___ में विभाजित होता है।
question_english: In a Graphic Presentation Program, each presentation is divided into ___.
explanation: A presentation is a collection of slides.
revision_fact: Slides are the building blocks of a presentation.

question_hindi: ___ सामान्य उद्देश्य जैसे फोटो एलबम या क्विज़ शो के लिए एक Predefined प्रेजेंटेशन है।
question_english: ___ is a predefined presentation for general purpose such as photo album or quiz show.
explanation: A Template is a ready-made, predefined presentation design used for common purposes like photo albums or quizzes.
trap_point: Do not confuse Template with Theme (a Theme is only colors/fonts; a Template can include full predefined content).
revision_fact: Templates provide predefined layouts for common presentation types.

question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से किस पैकेज को Slide Presentation के लिए प्रयुक्त किया जाता है?
question_english: Which of the following package is used for Slide Presentation?
explanation: MS PowerPoint is the dedicated package for creating slide presentations.
revision_fact: MS PowerPoint is Microsoft's presentation software.

question_hindi: ऑटो कॉन्टेंट विजार्ड में स्टार्ट और फिनिश के बीच कितने स्टेप हैं?
question_english: How many steps are there between Start and Finish in Auto Content Wizard?
explanation: The Auto Content Wizard flow is: Start → Presentation Type → Presentation Style → Presentation Options → Finish. So there are 3 steps between Start and Finish.
trap_point: Don't count Start and Finish themselves as steps.
revision_fact: Auto Content Wizard has 5 total screens; 3 fall strictly between Start and Finish.

question_hindi: यूजर पावर पॉइंट का उपयोग कर प्रस्तुत कर सकता है-
question_english: A user can present using PowerPoint-

options.text: ओवरहेड ट्रांसपेरेंसी और 35mm स्लाइड्स / Overhead transparencies and 35 mm slides
दर्शकों के हैंडआउट्स और रूपरेखाएं / Audience handouts and outlines
स्पीकर के नोट मुद्रित कर सकते हैं / Speaker notes can be printed
उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: PowerPoint supports multiple presentation output modes: overhead transparencies, 35mm slides, handouts, outlines, and printed speaker notes.
memory_trick: PowerPoint = flexible in every output form.
revision_fact: PowerPoint offers many ways to deliver/present content.

question_hindi: Microsoft PowerPoint 2010 प्रोग्राम में आपका फाइल ___ एक्सटेंशन में संग्रहित होता है।
question_english: In Microsoft PowerPoint 2010, your file is stored with ___ extension.
explanation: The default file extension for PowerPoint 2010 (and later, Open XML format) presentations is .pptx.
trap_point: .psd is Photoshop, .rtf/.docx are Word-related — common distractors.
revision_fact: Default PPT extension since PowerPoint 2007 is .pptx.

question_hindi: पॉवर पॉइंट प्रजेन्टेशन निम्नलिखित एप्लीकेशन प्रोग्राम का एक हिस्सा है-
question_english: PowerPoint Presentation is part of which application program?
explanation: PowerPoint is a component of the Microsoft Office suite.
trap_point: 'Libra Office' is a distractor spelling trap for LibreOffice (a different, non-Microsoft suite).
revision_fact: PowerPoint is one of the core MS Office applications.

question_hindi: पावर-प्वाइंट में निम्न में से कौनसी शॉर्टकट-की प्रेजेंटेशन को प्रारम्भ से शुरू करने के लिए उपयोग की जाती है?
question_english: Which shortcut key in PowerPoint is used to start the presentation from the beginning?
explanation: F5 starts the slide show from the very first slide.
trap_point: Shift+F5 (seen elsewhere in this set) starts from the CURRENT slide, not the beginning — don't mix them up.
revision_fact: F5 = Start slide show from Slide 1.

question_hindi: Microsoft PowerPoint 2007 में कौन से presentation view हैं?
question_english: Which presentation views are available in Microsoft PowerPoint 2007?

options.text: Normal, Slide Sorter / सामान्य, स्लाइड सॉर्टर
Note Page, Slide Show / नोट्स पेज, स्लाइड शो
Slide Master, Handout Master, Notes Master / स्लाइड मास्टर, हैंडआउट मास्टर, नोट्स मास्टर
उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: PowerPoint 2007 includes Normal, Slide Sorter, Notes Page, Slide Show, and the Master views (Slide/Handout/Notes Master) — all listed options are valid views.
revision_fact: PowerPoint offers both editing views and master views.

question_hindi: हैंडआउट के अंतर्गत एक पेज पर न्यूनतम एवं अधिकतम Slides को Print किया जा सकता है।
question_english: The minimum and maximum slides that can be printed on one page in handouts-
explanation: PowerPoint handout layouts allow printing 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, or 9 slides per page — so the minimum is 1 and maximum is 9.
trap_point: Numbers like 3,7 / 5,8 / 2,11 are not real handout layout options — only 1,2,3,4,6,9 exist.
revision_fact: Handout slide-per-page options: 1,2,3,4,6,9.

question_hindi: कौनसा पॉवर-प्वाइंट व्यू प्रेजेंटेशन के प्रत्येक स्लाइड को एक थम्बनेल के तौर पर डिस्प्ले करता है तथा स्लाइड्स को पुनः व्यवस्थित करने में उपयोगी है?
question_english: Which PowerPoint view displays each slide as a thumbnail and is useful for rearranging slides?
explanation: Slide Sorter view shows all slides as small thumbnails, making it easy to reorder them by dragging.
revision_fact: Slide Sorter View is used to see and rearrange all slides at once.

question_hindi: .........का उपयोग कम्प्यूटर पर Slide Show बनाने के लिए किया जाता है।
question_english: .........is used to create a Slide Show on a computer.

options.text: सुपर स्लाइड पैकेज / Super Slide Package
स्लाइड मेकर टूल्स / Slide Maker Tools

explanation: A Presentation Program (like PowerPoint) is the software category used to build slide shows.
revision_fact: Software used to build slide shows = Presentation Program.

question_hindi: ऑटो कॉन्टेंट विजार्ड में कौन सी presentation style होती हैं?
question_english: Which presentation styles are available in Auto Content Wizard?

options.text: On Screen Presentation / ऑन स्क्रीन प्रेजेन्टेशन
Block White Overheads / ब्लॉक व्हाइट ओवरहेड्स
उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: The Auto Content Wizard's style step offers On-Screen Presentation, Web Presentation, and Black-and-White Overheads as options.
revision_fact: Auto Content Wizard offers multiple output style choices.

question_hindi: ___ टाइटल बार में एक आइकन प्रदर्शित करता है जिसमें सामान्य रूप से उपयोग होने वाले कमांड जैसे सेव, अन्डू, और रिड्रू होते हैं।
question_english: ___ in the title bar displays an icon that contains commonly used commands like Save, Undo, and Redo.
explanation: The Quick Access Toolbar, placed on the title bar, gives one-click access to common commands like Save, Undo, and Redo.
trap_point: Ribbon holds all commands in tabs, but the small always-visible icon set on the title bar is Quick Access, not Ribbon.
revision_fact: Quick Access Toolbar sits on the title bar for frequent commands.

question_hindi: MS-Power Point में किस प्रकार का दृश्य उपलब्ध नहीं है?
question_english: Which type of view is not available in MS PowerPoint?
explanation: 'Extreme Animation' is not a real PowerPoint view; Normal, Slide Sorter, and Slide Show are all genuine views.
trap_point: Watch for invented view names mixed with real ones.
memory_trick: No such thing as 'Extreme' anything in PPT views.
revision_fact: Real PPT views: Normal, Outline, Slide Sorter, Notes Page, Reading, Slide Show.

question_hindi: एमएस पॉवर पॉइंट में मैक्रो किस ग्रुप टैब में पाया जाता है?
question_english: In MS PowerPoint, in which tab group is Macro found?
explanation: Macros are located in the Macros group under the View tab (also accessible via Developer tab if enabled).
trap_point: Many assume Macro is under Insert/Home, but it's under View (and Developer).
memory_trick: Macro hides in the View tab.
revision_fact: View tab houses the Macros group.

question_hindi: एम एस पॉवरप्वाइंट 2010 का प्रयोग किस कार्य के लिए किया जाता है?
question_english: MS PowerPoint 2010 is used for-
explanation: PowerPoint's core purpose is creating presentations.
revision_fact: PowerPoint is presentation software, not a database/programming tool.

question_hindi: ऑटो कॉन्टेंट विजार्ड के प्रथम चरण में कौनसे विकल्प होते हैं?
question_english: Which options are available in the first step of Auto Content Wizard?

options.text: उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: The Presentation Type step of the Auto Content Wizard offers categories like General, Corporate, Project, and Sales/Marketing.
memory_trick: Wizard's first content step = many categories.
revision_fact: Auto Content Wizard groups presentations by purpose/category.

question_hindi: PowerPoint की कौनसी सेटिंग प्रत्येक स्लाइड के बीच स्पेशल इफेक्ट जोड़ती है, जिससे स्लाइड appearance और प्रत्येक स्लाइड के बीच समय तय होता है?
question_english: Which setting in PowerPoint adds a special effect between each slide, determining appearance and timing between slides?
explanation: Transition settings control the visual effect and timing that occurs as PowerPoint moves from one slide to the next.
trap_point: Don't confuse Transition (between slides) with Animation (within a slide, on objects/text).
revision_fact: Slide Transitions control appearance/timing between slides.

question_hindi: एम एस पॉवर प्वाइंट प्रेजेंटेशन में कौनसा Format नहीं जोड़ा जा सकता है?
question_english: Which format cannot be added in MS PowerPoint presentation?
technical_proof: The book marks (c) .gif as the answer, but .gif is a standard raster image format that PowerPoint can insert directly, just like .jpeg. .wav is a standard insertable audio format. .html is a markup/web page format — it is not a media type you insert into a slide (you can only link to it via hyperlink); it cannot be 'added' as content the way image/audio files can.
explanation: The book marks (c) .gif as the answer, but .gif is a standard raster image format that PowerPoint can insert directly, just like .jpeg. .wav is a standard insertable audio format. .html is a markup/web page format — it is not a media type you insert into a slide (you can only link to it via hyperlink); it cannot be 'added' as content the way image/audio files can.
trap_point: 🚨 ANSWER KEY BUG DETECTED! Book answer (c) .gif is incorrect — GIF is a normal insertable image format in PowerPoint.
memory_trick: Images (jpeg/gif) and sounds (wav) insert directly; web pages (html) don't.
revision_fact: html is a web format, not an insertable media format.

question_hindi: जो सुविधा एक स्लाइड से बाहर निकालता है और अन्य में प्रवेश करता है, के बीच में गति प्रभाव लागू करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है?
question_english: Which feature is used to apply motion effect between exiting one slide and entering another?
explanation: Slide Transitions control the motion effect as one slide exits and the next enters.
revision_fact: Transitions handle movement between slides, not within them.

question_hindi: नई स्लाइड इंसर्ट करने की शॉर्टकट कीज़?
question_english: Shortcut key to insert a new slide
explanation: Ctrl+M inserts a new slide in PowerPoint.
trap_point: Ctrl+N is 'New Presentation/Document' in most Office apps, a common confusion here.
revision_fact: Ctrl+M inserts a new slide.

question_hindi: निम्न में से कौनसा Presentation software है?
question_english: Which of the following is a Presentation software?
explanation: PowerPoint is presentation software; Excel is spreadsheet, Paint Brush is graphics, Word is word processing.
revision_fact: PowerPoint is the dedicated presentation software among Office apps.

question_hindi: ऑटो कॉन्टेंट विजार्ड के किस स्टेप में स्लाइड प्रजेंटेशन टाइटल और फुटर डिफाइन किया जाता है?
question_english: In which step of Auto Content Wizard are slide presentation title and footer defined?
explanation: In the Auto Content Wizard, the Presentation Options step (step 3) is where the title and footer are defined.
revision_fact: Step 3 of Auto Content Wizard sets title/footer.

question_hindi: MS PowerPoint में किसी Presentation को सेव करने हेतु प्रयुक्त विकल्प है-
question_english: Options to save a presentation in PowerPoint are-

options.text: Using Ctrl+S key / Ctrl+S कुंजी के प्रयोग से
Using File Tab → Save As / फ़ाइल टैब → सेव विकल्प से
Using File Tab → Save / फ़ाइल टैब → सेव विकल्प से
उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: PowerPoint can be saved via Ctrl+S, or via the File tab's Save/Save As options — all are valid.
revision_fact: Multiple valid methods exist to save a PPT file.

question_hindi: पॉवर पॉइन्ट एप्लीकेशन यूजर को अनुमति देता है-
question_english: PowerPoint application allows the user to-

options.text: स्पीकर नोट्स के लिए नोट्स / Notes for the speaker
स्लाइड का पेपर प्रिंटआउट / Paper printout of slides
उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: PowerPoint supports speaker notes, printed slide handouts, and animated presentations — all are valid features.
revision_fact: PowerPoint supports notes, printouts, and animation together.

question_hindi: आप अपने हैंडआउट में हैडर एवं फुटर जोड़ने के लिए प्रयोग कर सकते हैं
question_english: To add header and footer in your handout you can use ...

options.text: उक्त सभी / All of the Above

explanation: Headers and footers for printed handouts are controlled via the Handout Master.
trap_point: Slide Master controls slide-level header/footer elements, not handout print layout headers.
revision_fact: Each master (Slide/Handout/Notes) governs its own output type.

question_hindi: वह व्यू जो प्रेजेंटेशन में स्लाइड को लघु रूप में दिखाता है कहलाता है
question_english: The view that shows slides in miniature form is called...

options.text: स्लाइड सॉर्टर व्यू / Slide Sorter View
नोट्स पेज व्यू / Notes Page View

explanation: Slide Sorter View shows miniature thumbnails of all slides.
revision_fact: Slide Sorter View displays slides as small thumbnails.

question_hindi: Slide Layout Command किस टैब के अंतर्गत आता है?
question_english: Slide Layout Command comes under which tab?
explanation: The Layout command (Slide Layout) is found in the Slides group under the Home tab.
trap_point: Many expect Design tab, but layout selection is under Home.
revision_fact: Slide Layout is a Home tab command.

question_hindi: कस्टम एनिमेशन टास्क पेन का कौनसा विकल्प आपको प्रीसेट अथवा कस्टम घूर्णन पथ लागू करने की अनुमति प्रदान करता है?
question_english: Which option in Custom Animation Task Pane allows applying preset or custom motion paths?

options.text: उक्त सभी / All of the Above

explanation: 'Add Effect' in the Custom Animation Task Pane lets you choose preset motion paths or draw a custom path.
revision_fact: Motion paths are applied via Add Effect in Custom Animation.

question_hindi: पॉवर पाइंट में कौन सा फाइल फॉर्मेट जोड़ा जा सकता है?
question_english: Which file format can be added in PowerPoint?
explanation: PowerPoint supports inserting image formats like .gif/.jpg and audio formats like .wav.
memory_trick: Images and sound both insert fine.
revision_fact: Common media formats (.gif, .jpg, .wav) are all supported in PPT.

question_hindi: पॉवर-पॉइंट एक ___ है।
question_english: PowerPoint is a ___.

options.text: उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं / None of the above

explanation: PowerPoint is application software, used by end-users for a specific task (presentations), unlike system software which runs the computer itself.
memory_trick: App software = tool for the user's task.
revision_fact: PowerPoint is classified as application software.

question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौनसे PowerPoint में प्रयुक्त Transition Effect के प्रकार हैं-
question_english: Which of the following are types of transition effects used in PowerPoint?
explanation: PowerPoint offers a large gallery of transitions across Subtle/Exciting/Dynamic categories including Fade, Push, Wipe, Reveal, Split, Cut, Cover, Rotate, etc.
memory_trick: PPT has dozens of transition styles.
revision_fact: Transitions are grouped as Subtle, Exciting, and Dynamic Content.

question_hindi: प्रस्तुति में सभी स्लाइड को एक समान लुक देने के लिए निम्न में से क्या उपयोग करना चाहिए?
question_english: Which should be used to give all slides a uniform look in a presentation?

options.text: Slide Layout विकल्प / Slide Layout Option
एक स्लाइड जोड़ें विकल्प / Add a Slide Option

explanation: Applying a Design Template gives all slides a consistent, uniform look.
revision_fact: Design Templates enforce consistent styling across all slides.

question_hindi: पॉवर-पॉइंट का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से किस कार्य हेतु किया जाता है?
question_english: PowerPoint is mainly used for-
explanation: PowerPoint's primary purpose is to create presentations.
revision_fact: PowerPoint's core use-case is presentations.

question_hindi: कौनसा अनुप्रयोग प्रदर्शन तैयार करने के लिए उपयुक्त होता है?
question_english: Which application is suitable for preparing presentations?
explanation: PowerPoint is the appropriate application for preparing presentations, unlike Photoshop (image editing), Outlook (email), or Internet Explorer (browsing).
memory_trick: Presentation = PowerPoint, not a browser or mail client.
revision_fact: PowerPoint is purpose-built for presentations.

question_hindi: एम एस पॉवर प्वाइंट में पहली स्लाइड पर जाने के लिए कौनसी Shortcut key का उपयोग किया जाता है?
question_english: Shortcut key to go to first slide in MS PowerPoint-
explanation: Ctrl+Home moves to the first slide in Normal/Slide Sorter view, consistent with its 'go to start' behavior in other Office apps.
revision_fact: Ctrl+Home jumps to the first slide.

question_hindi: निम्न में से कौनसा Presentation का basic element है?
question_english: Which of the following is a basic element of Presentation?
explanation: Slides are the fundamental building blocks of any presentation.
revision_fact: A presentation is fundamentally composed of slides.

question_hindi: एक नया प्रेजेंटेशन निम्न में से किस बनाया जा सकता है?
question_english: A new presentation can be created from ...

options.text: उपरोक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: New presentations can start blank, from an existing presentation, or from a design template — all are valid starting points.
revision_fact: PowerPoint offers multiple ways to start a new presentation.

question_hindi: Presentation बनाने के लिए प्रोग्राम का उपयोग किया जाता है-
question_english: Program used to create Presentation-
technical_proof: The book lists (c) Access as correct, but Access is a database program, not a presentation tool. PowerPoint (b) is unambiguously the program used to create presentations.
explanation: The book lists (c) Access as correct, but Access is a database program, not a presentation tool. PowerPoint (b) is unambiguously the program used to create presentations.
trap_point: 🚨 ANSWER KEY BUG DETECTED! Book answer (c) Access is wrong — Access is a database management program, not a presentation tool.
memory_trick: Presentation is created only in PowerPoint, never a database app.
revision_fact: PowerPoint creates presentations; Access manages databases.

question_hindi: एक प्रस्तुति में स्लाइड्स लाने के लिए क्या विशेष प्रभाव इस्तेमाल किया जाता है?
question_english: What special effect is used to bring slides in a presentation?
explanation: Transition is the effect that brings one slide in as another leaves.
revision_fact: Transitions govern how slides enter/exit during a show.

question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौनसा MS PowerPoint में एनीमेशन को व्यक्त करता है-
question_english: Which of the following represents animation in MS PowerPoint?
explanation: All the listed effects (Fly In/Random Bars/Bounce = Entrance; Darken/Fill Color/Wave = Emphasis; Pulse/Teeter/Shock = Exit-related) are genuine PowerPoint animation effects.
memory_trick: Many named effects, all real animations.
revision_fact: PowerPoint animation categories: Entrance, Emphasis, Exit, Motion Path.

question_hindi: निम्न में से कौन स्लाइड शो व्यू में स्लाइड्स को आगे नहीं चलायेगा?
question_english: Which of the following will not advance slides in Slide Show view?
explanation: Esc ends/exits the Slide Show rather than advancing it; Mouse click, Space, and Enter all advance to the next slide.
revision_fact: Esc key ends a running slide show instead of advancing it.

question_hindi: वर्तमान में खुले प्रेजेंटेशन में किस शॉर्टकट कुंजी से नई स्लाइड डाली जाती है?
question_english: Shortcut key to insert a new slide in the current presentation?
explanation: Ctrl+M inserts a new slide.
memory_trick: Ctrl+M = new slide, remembered like before.
revision_fact: Ctrl+M inserts a new slide in the current presentation.

question_hindi: पॉवर पॉइंट में presentation को बनाने में प्रयुक्त पेज को ___ कहा जाता है।
question_english: In PowerPoint, the page used to create a presentation is called ___.
explanation: The page unit in PowerPoint is called a Slide.
revision_fact: Each page/unit in a PPT file is a slide.

question_hindi: माइक्रोसॉफ्ट पॉवर पॉइन्ट की फाइल का By Default नाम होता है-
question_english: Default name of Microsoft PowerPoint file is-
explanation: A new, unsaved PowerPoint file is by default named 'Presentation1', similar to how Excel defaults to 'Book1' and Word to 'Document1'.
trap_point: Compare with Excel's 'Book1' and Word's 'Document1' — don't mix up the app-specific default names.
revision_fact: Default unsaved-file names: PowerPoint=Presentation1, Word=Document1, Excel=Book1.

question_hindi: अपने प्रेजेंटेशन को सेव करने के लिए-
question_english: To save your presentation-

options.text: Click Office button or File tab to save

explanation: Both the Office/File tab Save option and the Ctrl+S shortcut can be used to save a presentation.
revision_fact: Ctrl+S and File tab Save both work identically.

question_hindi: ड्रॉइंग, फोटोग्राफ्स, मूवीज और सिमुलेशन ___ की श्रेणी के अंतर्गत आते हैं।
question_english: Drawing, photographs, movies and simulations fall under the category of ...
explanation: Drawings, photographs, movies, and simulations are broadly categorized as Graphics in presentation software terminology.
revision_fact: Graphics is the umbrella term covering drawings, photos, movies, simulations.

question_hindi: प्रस्तुतकर्ता (Presenter) पर उपलब्ध स्लाइड शो विकल्प सभी को समाहित करता है केवल निम्न को छोड़कर
question_english: Slide Show options available in Presenter include all except ...
explanation: 'Meeting Reminder' is not a real Presenter View/Slide Show command; Transition, Speaker Notes, and Navigation controls all genuinely exist.
revision_fact: Presenter tools include navigation, notes, and transitions but not meeting reminders.

question_hindi: ..........एक प्रस्तुति के लिए वर्तमान विषय के बारे में जानकारी संग्रहित करता है, प्लेसहोल्डर्स का लेआउट, बुलेट वर्ण और अन्य स्वरूप जो किसी प्रस्तुति में सभी स्लाइड को प्रभावित करते हैं।
question_english: .......stores information about the current topic for a presentation, placeholder layouts, bullet characters, and other formats that affect all slides in a presentation.
explanation: The Slide Master stores the layout, placeholders, bullet styles, and formatting that apply across all slides.
trap_point: 'Slide Painter/Layer/Bank' are invented distractor terms.
memory_trick: Master = the template controlling every slide's look.
revision_fact: Slide Master governs global layout/format for the whole presentation.

question_english: Basic formatting tools are available in the ___ tab.
explanation: The Home tab contains basic formatting tools like font, paragraph, and styles groups.
memory_trick: Home tab = home base for basic formatting.
revision_fact: Home tab holds font/paragraph formatting tools.

question_hindi: एम.एस.पॉवर पॉइंट में ऑप्शन ___ के प्रयोग से एक पेज बहु स्लाइड प्रिंट की जाती है
question_english: Which option in PowerPoint is used to print multiple slides on a page?
explanation: The Handouts print layout lets you print multiple slides per printed page.
revision_fact: Handout print layout supports multiple slides per page.

question_hindi: स्लाइड पर वे ऑब्जेक्ट्स जो टेक्स्ट रखते हैं, कहलाते हैं
question_english: Objects on slides that hold text are called ...
explanation: Placeholders are the containers on a slide layout designed to hold text, images, or other content.
trap_point: 'Textholders' sounds plausible but is not the real PowerPoint term.
memory_trick: Placeholder = the box that 'holds a place' for content.
revision_fact: Text/content containers on a slide layout are called Placeholders.

question_hindi: ..........एक विशेष स्लाइड है जो प्रेजेंटेशन की सभी स्लाइड्स के लिए टाइटल और टेक्स्ट के फॉर्मेट एवं स्वरूप को निर्धारित करती है
question_english: ..........is a special slide that controls the title and text format of all slides in the presentation.
explanation: The Slide Master is the special slide governing title and text formatting across the whole presentation.
memory_trick: Master controls the format of every slide.
revision_fact: Slide Master defines the format template for the entire deck.

question_hindi: कौन सी Keys के संयोजन से पॉवर प्वांट प्रस्तुतीकरण में नया स्लाइड जोड़ा जा सकता है?
question_english: Which key combination adds a new slide in a PowerPoint presentation?
explanation: Ctrl+M adds a new slide.
revision_fact: Ctrl+M inserts a new slide (repeated fact — high yield).

question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा Power Point में स्लाइड का Default पेज सेटअप ओरिएंटेशन है?
question_english: Which of the following is the default page setup orientation in PowerPoint?
explanation: PowerPoint slides default to Landscape orientation (wider than tall), unlike Word documents which default to Portrait.
trap_point: Don't confuse with Word's default Portrait orientation.
memory_trick: PPT slides are wide screens → Landscape.
revision_fact: Default PowerPoint slide orientation is Landscape.

question_hindi: एक नया प्रेजेंटेशन से बनाया जा सकता है
question_english: A new presentation can be created from-
explanation: All three methods — blank, template-based, or from an existing file — are valid ways to start a new presentation.
revision_fact: New presentations can start blank, from templates, or from existing files.

question_hindi: Presentation Slide के Text की टूलबार में Maximum Size होती है-
question_english: Maximum text size in PowerPoint Slide toolbar is-
explanation: The font size dropdown in the formatting toolbar/ribbon goes up to 96pt by default (though larger custom values can be typed in manually up to 4000pt).
trap_point: This is the toolbar dropdown max, not the absolute typed-in max (which is much higher — see Q177).
revision_fact: Font size dropdown list maxes at 96pt; manual entry allows far larger.

question_hindi: ट्रांजिशन इफेक्ट ___ के लिए लागू होते हैं
question_english: Transition effects are applied to...
explanation: Transition effects apply at the whole-slide level, not to individual text/images/objects (that's Animation's job).
trap_point: Confusing Transition (slide-level) with Animation (object-level) is the classic trap in this exam.
revision_fact: Transitions act on entire slides, not individual objects.

question_hindi: एम.एस.पॉवरपॉइंट व्यू जो केवल टेक्स्ट, शीर्षक और बुलेट प्रदर्शित करता है
question_english: PowerPoint view that displays only text, titles, and bullets
explanation: Outline View shows only the text content (titles and bullet points) of slides, hiding images/graphics.
revision_fact: Outline View displays slide text content without graphics.

question_hindi: Power Point में किसी स्लाइड के नोट्स को क्या कहा जाता है?
question_english: Notes of a slide in PowerPoint are called-
explanation: Notes attached to a slide (visible to the presenter, not the audience) are called Speaker Notes.
revision_fact: Per-slide presenter notes are called Speaker Notes.

question_hindi: अगर आप सभी स्लाइड का Look एक जैसा ही चाहिए, तो निम्न में से कौन से तरीके का आप उपयोग करेंगे?
question_english: If you want all slides to have the same look, which option will you use?
explanation: Applying a Design Template gives a consistent look to all slides.
revision_fact: Design Template ensures uniform styling across all slides.

question_hindi: पॉवरपॉइंट में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा व्यू होता है?
question_english: Which of the following view exists in PowerPoint?
explanation: Slide Sorter View is a genuine PowerPoint view; 'Document View' and 'Play Slide View' are invented distractor names.
memory_trick: Only Slide Sorter is real here.
revision_fact: Genuine PPT views: Normal, Outline, Slide Sorter, Notes Page, Reading, Slide Show.

question_hindi: स्लाइड ___ का प्रयोग करते हुए प्रेजेंटेशन में सभी स्लाइडों के फॉन्ट की विशेषताओं को बदला जा सकता है
question_english: Using slide ___, you can change font features for all slides in presentation
explanation: The Slide Master lets you change font characteristics globally across every slide.
trap_point: 'Typicon' is a made-up distractor.
revision_fact: Slide Master governs font settings for all slides at once.

question_hindi: Power Point में Ready Made फॉन्ट कलर और ग्राफिक्स प्रभावों का चयन करके नई प्रस्तुति किसके माध्यम से बनाई जा सकती है?
question_english: In PowerPoint, new presentation with ready-made font color and graphic effects can be created through-
explanation: Design Templates come with predefined font colors and graphic effect schemes ready to apply.
trap_point: Note: option D 'Presentation Template' is a near-duplicate distractor of B — the officially recognized PowerPoint term is Design Template.
revision_fact: Design Templates bundle predefined color schemes and graphic effects.

question_hindi: सिलेक्टेड डिजाइन टेम्पलेट ___ पर अप्लाई किया जाता है।
question_english: Selected design template is applied on ___.
explanation: A design template can be applied to all slides in the current presentation, and can also be set as default for future presentations.
revision_fact: A design template's scope can extend to current and future presentations.

question_hindi: निम्न में से कौन आपके प्रदर्शन की मुद्रित प्रतिलिपी उपलब्ध करवाता है
question_english: Which of the following provides a printed copy of your presentation?

options.text: उक्त सभी / All of the above

explanation: Audience Handouts are specifically the printed copies given out to the audience.
trap_point: Note options B/D exist as distractors but the standard specific term for audience printouts is Handout.
revision_fact: Printed slide copies for the audience are called Audience Handouts.

question_hindi: वेक्टर और ___ दो प्रकार के कम्प्यूटर ग्राफिक्स होते हैं
question_english: Vector and ___ are two types of computer graphics.
explanation: The two fundamental computer graphics types are Vector and Raster (bitmap).
trap_point: 'Scalar/Sector/Rektor' are meaningless distractors designed to confuse spelling of 'Raster'.
memory_trick: Vector vs Raster — the classic graphics pair.
revision_fact: Computer graphics are classified as Vector or Raster.

question_hindi: किसी प्रस्तुति में ऑडियंस को स्लाइड की प्रिंटआउट्स प्रस्तुति के ठीक पहले, समय के दौरान या उसके बाद भौतिक रूप से वितरित की जाती हैं, क्या कहलाते हैं?
question_english: Printed copies of slides distributed to audience before, during, or after presentation are called-
explanation: These distributed printed copies are called Handouts.
revision_fact: Handouts are physical slide printouts given to the audience.

question_hindi: किसी स्लाइड की प्रतिलिपि बनाने के लिए किस शॉर्टकट कुंजी का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
question_english: Shortcut key to duplicate a slide
explanation: Ctrl+D duplicates the selected slide.
revision_fact: Ctrl+D duplicates a slide in PowerPoint.

question_hindi: माइक्रोसॉफ्ट पॉवरपॉइंट में निम्न में से कौन सा 'होम' टैब के 'क्लिपबोर्ड' समूह में प्रकट नहीं होता है?
question_english: Which of the following does NOT appear in 'Clipboard' group under Home tab?
explanation: 'New Slide' belongs to the Slides group, not Clipboard; Paste, Copy, and Format Painter are all genuine Clipboard group commands.
trap_point: New Slide is a very common item people misplace into Clipboard.
revision_fact: New Slide is in the Slides group; Clipboard holds Paste, Copy, Cut, Format Painter.

question_hindi: एक प्रस्तुति को शुरू करने के लिए की-बोर्ड की शॉर्टकट कुंजी क्या है?
question_english: Keyboard shortcut to start a presentation-
explanation: F5 starts the slide show from the beginning.
revision_fact: F5 launches the slide show from the very start.

question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प प्रस्तुति कि एक मुद्रित प्रति प्रदान करता है?
question_english: Which option provides a printed copy of the presentation?
explanation: Audience Handout specifically provides printed copies of the presentation for the audience.
memory_trick: Printed copy for viewers = Audience Handout.
revision_fact: Audience Handouts are the print output meant for viewers.

question_hindi: किसी स्लाइड में speaker notes का क्या उपयोग है?
question_english: What is the use of speaker notes in a slide?

options.text: किसी स्लाइड में नोट्स जोड़ने देता है जो प्रस्तुति देने एवं तैयार करने में सहायता करता है / Add notes to help prepare and deliver presentation
कम्प्यूटर स्पीकर में आउटपुट पाने के लिए / For output in computer speaker
स्लाइड को प्रस्तुत करने के लिए / To present slide

explanation: Speaker Notes let the presenter add reminders/details to help prepare and deliver the presentation; they are not visible to the audience during the show.
memory_trick: Notes help the speaker, not the audience.
revision_fact: Speaker Notes assist the presenter in delivering the talk.

question_hindi: विभिन्न Slides में Motion Effect लागू करने के लिए आप PowerPoint का कौनसा फीचर use करेंगे?
question_english: Which feature of PowerPoint will you use to apply motion effects in different slides?
explanation: Slide Transition is used to apply motion effects as slides change during the show.
trap_point: This question phrases 'motion effect between slides' which maps to Transition, not object Animation.
revision_fact: Motion effects moving between slides are handled by Slide Transitions.

question_hindi: Presentation में किसी Slide के लिए Custom Timing सेट करने के लिए किस Option का उपयोग किया जाता है?
question_english: Which option is used to set custom timing for a slide in a presentation?
explanation: The Rehearse Timings feature lets you record custom timing for each slide as you rehearse the presentation.
trap_point: 'Slide Timings' sounds correct but PowerPoint's actual named feature is 'Rehearse Timings'.
revision_fact: Rehearse Timings sets custom per-slide timing during a run-through.

question_hindi: Presentation के Print out को क्या कहा जाता है?
question_english: What is the printout of a presentation called?
explanation: The printed output of a presentation is called a Handout.
revision_fact: Handout is the standard term for a printed presentation.

question_hindi: एम.एस.पॉवरपॉइंट में प्रयुक्त एनीमेशन Effects के प्रकार
question_english: Types of animation effects in MS PowerPoint
explanation: PowerPoint's four animation categories are Entrance, Emphasis, Exit, and Motion Paths.
memory_trick: 4 animation types: Entrance, Emphasis, Exit, Motion Path.
revision_fact: Animation effects fall into Entrance, Emphasis, Exit, Motion Path.

question_hindi: Power Point की कौनसी सेटिंग प्रत्येक स्लाइड के बीच स्पेशल इफेक्ट जोड़ती है, जिससे स्लाइड का appearance और प्रत्येक स्लाइड के बीच समय तय होता है?
question_english: Which setting in PowerPoint adds a special effect between each slide, determining appearance and timing between slides?
explanation: This is an exact repeat of Q22 — Transition Setting adds effects/timing between slides.
revision_fact: Duplicate of Q22 — high repeat frequency signals importance.

question_hindi: हैंडआउट के अंतर्गत एक पेज पर न्यूनतम और अधिकतम कितनी Slides Print की जा सकती हैं?
question_english: Under handouts, what is the minimum and maximum number of slides that can be printed on a page?
explanation: Handout print layouts range from 1 up to 9 slides per page, matching Q13's concept with reordered options.
memory_trick: Same fact as Q13, different option order.
revision_fact: Handout min/max slides per page: 1 to 9.

question_hindi: माइक्रोसॉफ्ट पॉवरपॉइंट में डिफ़ॉल्ट ओरिएंटेशन क्या होता है?
question_english: Default page orientation in MS PowerPoint
explanation: PowerPoint slides default to Landscape orientation.
trap_point: 'Right-slated' is a nonsense distractor.
revision_fact: Default slide orientation in PowerPoint is Landscape.

question_hindi: जब आप प्रेजेन्टेशन को Open करते हैं, तब लेफ्ट पैनल में कौनसा टैब नहीं होता?
question_english: When you open a presentation, which tab is NOT in the left panel?
explanation: The left panel offers Slides and Outline tabs, but not a separate 'Notes' tab.
memory_trick: Left panel = Slides + Outline only, no Notes tab.
revision_fact: The left navigation panel contains Slides and Outline tabs, not Notes.

question_hindi: प्रेजेंटेशन में स्लाइड को प्रवेश करने के लिए स्पेशल इफेक्ट को ................ कहते हैं।
question_english: The special effect applied for a slide to enter in a presentation is called ................
explanation: The effect for a slide entering during a show is called a Transition.
revision_fact: Transitions govern how a slide enters/exits during playback.

question_hindi: स्लाइड शॉ के दौरान प्रत्येक स्लाइड के मध्य एक विशेष प्रभाव होता है, उसे कहा जाता है-
question_english: During a slide show, the special effect between slides is called-
explanation: The between-slide effect during a show is Transition (repeated concept).
revision_fact: Repeated core fact: transitions occur between slides during a show.

question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विकल्प निम्नलिखित कथनों की सत्यता का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है? (i) पॉवरपॉइंट स्लाइड का ओरिएंटेशन पोर्ट्रेट रूप में सेट नहीं किया जा सकता (ii) पृष्ठ संख्या माइक्रोसॉफ्ट पॉवरपॉइंट प्रेजेंटेशन स्लाइड के ऊपरी भाग में डाली जा सकती है
question_english: Which option best describes the truth of the following statements? (i) Cannot set slide orientation as portrait (ii) Page number can be inserted at the top of slide
explanation: Statement (i) is False — PowerPoint CAN set slide orientation to Portrait via Slide Size settings. Statement (ii) is True — a slide number placeholder can be positioned at the top (or anywhere) on the slide layout.
trap_point: Don't assume PowerPoint is locked to Landscape — Portrait is selectable in Slide Size options.
memory_trick: PPT allows Portrait; page numbers can go anywhere including top.
revision_fact: PowerPoint supports both Portrait and Landscape orientations; slide number placement is flexible.

question_hindi: जब नया एम.एस.पॉवर पॉइंट प्रेजेंटेशन खोला जाता है, लेफ्ट पेनल पर उपलब्ध टैब होते हैं
question_english: When a new MS PowerPoint presentation is opened, the left panel contains tabs ...
explanation: The left panel shows Slides and Outline tabs (there is no separate Notes tab here).
memory_trick: Left panel = Slides + Outline (repeat of Q85 logic).
revision_fact: Left navigation panel tabs: Slides and Outline only.

question_hindi: निम्न में से कौनसा युग्म एनीमेशन प्रभाव को इंगित करता है?
question_english: Which of the following pair indicates animation effects?

options.text: Appear, Fly in, Float in, Split

explanation: All the listed items are genuine PowerPoint animation effect names spanning Entrance/Emphasis/Exit categories.
memory_trick: All groups list real animation effects.
revision_fact: PowerPoint animation names include Appear, Fly In, Wipe, Fade, Split, etc.

question_hindi: हैंडआउट के अंतर्गत एक पेज पर निम्नलिखित में से कितनी Slides Print की जा सकती हैं?
question_english: Under handouts, how many slides can be printed on a page from the following options?
explanation: The genuine handout layout options are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, or 9 slides per page — matching option B exactly.
trap_point: Options with 5, 7, 8, or 10 slides per page are fabricated; PowerPoint does not offer those handout layouts.
revision_fact: Handout layouts support exactly 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, or 9 slides per page.

question_hindi: Transition के प्रकार हैं-
question_english: Types of transitions are-
explanation: PowerPoint groups transitions into three categories: Subtle, Exciting, and Dynamic Content.
revision_fact: Transition gallery is organized into Subtle, Exciting, and Dynamic Content groups.

question_hindi: Transition Effect हैं-
question_english: Transition effects are-
explanation: All listed items (aside from the invented 'Converter') largely correspond to real PowerPoint transition names such as Cut, Fade, Wipe, Split, Clock, Flip, Zoom, Checkerboard, Pan, Rotate, Orbit.
trap_point: 'Converter' is not a genuine transition name, but since the option is bundled with real ones under 'All of the above', the intended answer per the key remains (d).
memory_trick: PPT transitions span dozens of named effects.
revision_fact: Numerous transition effect names exist across Subtle/Exciting/Dynamic categories.

question_hindi: Slide का Background बदलने के लिए किस Tab का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
question_english: Which tab is used to change the background of a slide?
explanation: The Design tab contains the Background Styles/Format Background options.
revision_fact: Slide background settings are found under the Design tab.

question_hindi: इनमें से किसको Slide Background के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है?
question_english: Which of these is used as a slide background?
explanation: PowerPoint slide backgrounds can be filled with solid color, gradient, texture, pattern, or picture — all listed options qualify.
memory_trick: Any fill type can be a background.
revision_fact: Slide backgrounds support gradients, textures, and pictures among other fills.

question_hindi: पावर पॉइंट शो में कौनसा फाइल फॉर्मेट एड कर सकते हैं?
question_english: Which file format can be added in PowerPoint show?
explanation: PowerPoint supports inserting image (JPG), video (MPEG), and audio (WAV) files.
memory_trick: Images, video, and audio all insertable.
revision_fact: PowerPoint accepts image, video, and audio file formats.

question_hindi: पॉवर पॉइंट में ctrl+E कमांड का use होता है-
question_english: Ctrl+E command in PowerPoint is used for-
explanation: Ctrl+E centers the selected text/paragraph, consistent with the same shortcut across Office apps.
